- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.6.2
- Git version: 2.20.1
- Operating system: CentOS 7
- Database (use `[x]`):
  - [ ] PostgreSQL
  - [ ] MySQL
  - [ ] MSSQL
  - [x] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [x] Yes (provide example URL) [https://observatory.mozilla.org/analyze/try.gitea.io](https://observatory.mozilla.org/analyze/try.gitea.io), see "Anti-CSRF tokens set without using the SameSite flag"
  - [ ] No
  - [ ] Not relevant
- Log gist: N/A

## Description
The [SameSite](https://www.owasp.org/index.php/SameSite) setting should be enabled on the session and CSRF cookies as an added prevention against CSRF. [Mozilla](https://blog.mozilla.org/security/2018/04/24/same-site-cookies-in-firefox-60/) does a good job of explaining its purpose, but the gist is that it prevents cookies being sent in a request initiated from a foreign origin.
